semiconductor_relevance: High — SION SYSTEM specializes in automated guided vehicles (AGVs) that enhance material handling in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: SION SYSTEM develops advanced automated guided vehicles (AGVs) designed for efficient transport tasks within factories and logistics warehouses. Their innovative FSLAM guidance system allows for precise navigation in tight spaces, significantly improving production capacity and reducing reliance on manual labor.
capabilities: Customizable lift-up and conveyor mounting features

regional_presence.Japan: The company has developed its FSLAM guidance system in Japan, indicating a strong local presence in the robotics and automation sector.
